intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Senna is patting down her apron pockets one at a time, in order.

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “Spectacles. I had them. I’m holding a seed the size of a comma, and I can’t see it.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: She tries her magnifying lens on the seed, then gives the lens a look of betrayal.

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “I’ve retraced my steps. I’ve checked inside the herbal. Twice.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: The spectacles are on top of her head, tucked in beside the pencil.

options.labelText: “Senna. Top of your head. Next to the pencil.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She reaches up and finds them. She puts them on, and you come into focus.

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “Huh. I had you down as blurrier.”

options.labelText: “I’ll help. Where did you last have them? Let’s retrace.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: You help. Soon her entire apron is laid out in labeled rows.

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “Gone. I’ll have to identify the seed by smell.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: From the top of her head, the spectacles have an excellent view of all this.
